installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Tidy Paper Java 25 Installation Script
# Server Files Path: /mnt/server

apk update
apk add --no-cache curl git jq

cd /mnt/server

echo "==================================================="
echo " Installing Tidy Pre-Flight Container Orchestrator "
echo "==================================================="

GITHUB_REPO="Kenzi-Siaufandi/tidy"
if [ "${TIDY_VERSION}" = "latest" ] || [ -z "${TIDY_VERSION}" ]; then
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(curl -s "https://api.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_REPO}/releases/latest" | jq -r '.assets[] | select(.name=="tidy") | .browser_download_url')
    if [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ] || [ "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" = "null" ]; then
        DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPO}/releases/latest/download/tidy"
    fi
else
    DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPO}/releases/download/${TIDY_VERSION}/tidy"
fi

echo "Downloading Tidy from ${DOWNLOAD_URL}..."
curl -sSL -o tidy "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" || echo "[!] Note: If release is not yet uploaded, please upload the tidy binary manually."

if [ -f tidy ]; then
    chmod +x tidy
    echo "[✓] Tidy binary installed successfully!"
fi

# Accept EULA automatically
echo "eula=true" > eula.txt

echo "==================================================="
echo " Installation Complete! Ready for Java 25 Startup "
echo "==================================================="
